title: a16z Podcast: On Recent Consolidation in the Healthcare Industry

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Many of the healthcare headlines lately have been about consolidation in the industry: Walmart and Humana; Aetna and CVS; Amazon.
reader_summary.overview: Many of the healthcare headlines lately have been about consolidation in the industry: Walmart and Humana; Aetna and CVS; Amazon, JP Morgan, and Berkshire Hathaway. But what does it all mean for patients, and startups -- Will it decrease costs? What opportunities may arise as a result?

key_points.text: In this quick hallway-style conversation, originally recorded as a video.
